Skipping duplicates is the safest choice. Importing should not overwrite notes or other details I’ve already curated. Adding to the existing collection rather than replacing it is also correct.

Export should include archived bookmarks so it truly contains the whole collection. If the standard file supports folders, placing archived items in a clearly named “Archived” folder would make their status understandable, but they should not be omitted.

Because import and export are occasional management tasks, I’d place them in Settings rather than keep permanent buttons in the main header. The round-trip behaviour and preservation of titles, tags, descriptions, and original dates otherwise match what I want.
